hotels.title: Elegant Sao Paulo Urban Retreat with Onsite Restaurant & Outdoor Pool
hotels.description: Stay in the heart of Sao Paulo’s vibrant high-rise Vila Olimpia district, where riverside views and easy access to the JK Iguatemi shopping centre set the tone for a smooth city stay. Here, the atmosphere is calm and contemporary, with classic decor and modern rooms that give you space to unwind between sightseeing. Start the day with a generous breakfast at Familia Castro, then return in the evening for classic Brazilian dishes in a relaxed setting. Take a break by the outdoor pool while enjoying a cooling cocktail or fit in a session at the fitness centre before heading out to explore. With Ibirapuera Park and Avenue Paulista Imobiliaria just a short drive away, exploring Sao Paulo is a breeze at this charming stay.
